current.subject: Recap: Apex technical validation, Sept 28
current.body:
Hi Frank, Ingrid and Pete,

Thanks for your time today. Here is what we covered.

Shown: the shipment tracking feed on your telematics sample, with positions updating every 30 seconds versus every 5 minutes today, and the dispatcher dashboard with late loads flagged. Late load alerts go to email or a webhook, so text messages can run through your paging tool.

Open: Canadian data residency. Omar will check with our hosting team and come back by Thursday, October 1st. It would help to see the contract wording on shipment data and who in legal can confirm how it applies to telematics.

Pricing: you asked for 50 seats and 400 seats. We said we can show both, and we will confirm timing separately.

Could we set a time to review Omar's answer once you have it?

Best,
Leah

original.subject: Recap: Harbor Freightways technical validation
original.body:
Hi Frank, Ingrid and Pete,

Thanks for your time today. Here is what we covered.

Validated: In the sandbox with your telematics sample, positions updated every 30 seconds, compared with every 5 minutes today. The dispatcher dashboard flags late loads in red and lets you drill into any truck. Late load alerts go to email or a webhook, so text messages can run through your paging tool, which takes webhooks.

Still open: Canadian data residency. Omar will check with our hosting team and come back by Thursday, October 1st. It would help to see the Canadian contract wording on shipment data, and to know who in legal can confirm whether it covers telematics.

Pricing: we will show both 50 seats and 400 seats.

Could we find a time to go over Omar's answer and the pricing after October 1st? Let us know what works.

Leah
